attribute.agility.description.message: Coordination, balance, reflexes, precise movement, and aim.

attribute.intelligence.description.message: Observation, analysis, memory, diagnosis, planning, and technical learning.

attribute.perception.description.message: Sensory awareness, spotting danger or details, tracking, ranged accuracy support, and noticing what others miss.

attribute.strength.description.message: Physical force, lifting, carrying, heavy weapons, and resisting forced movement.

attribute.toughness.description.message: Health, stamina, pain tolerance, recovery, and environmental resistance.

attribute.willpower.description.message: Concentration, courage, self-control, and supernatural control or resistance.
